name: CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2025
information:
This competition **only** has the **3x3x3 Fewest Moves** event. For a competition experience more suitable for first-time competitors and competitors interested in regular speedsolving events, please check out **[CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2025)**. The top 3 competitors at this FMC championship will be recognized during the award ceremony at Southeast Championship 2025.

This competition will take place at multiple locations across the Southeast; check out the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2025#52332-locations) for more details, including the separate competitor limits for each location.

This competition is supported by **[Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about)**
